title: The full gate's node-helper-tests stage does not run scripts/include-to-mod.test.mjs, so no FULL covers the conversion tool's tests
outcome: The full gate's node-helper-tests stage does not run scripts/include-to-mod.test.mjs, so no FULL covers the conversion tool's tests
acceptance: The full gate's node-helper-tests stage runs scripts/include-to-mod.test.mjs while that file exists, shown by a full or focused launcher run listing its tests; or the tool and its test have been removed, which closes the item.
